title: The Bible as the Word of God
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 3 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child says how the Bible differs from other books: it is God's word, inspired by God and useful for teaching (2 Timothy 3:16).

floor.prerequisite: Knows the Old Testament has books.
floor.question: How many books are in the Old Testament?

representations: a Bible beside a storybook and a textbook
steps: Look at a Bible and other books.
Say what makes the Bible different.

board.do: Write 2 Timothy 3:16: All Scripture is God-breathed.

board.say: What does this tell us about the Bible?

board.do: Wait for the child to say it is from God.
Write: the Bible is God's word.

misconceptions.ask: How is the Bible different from a storybook?
misconceptions.repair: Read 2 Timothy 3:16. Compare who gave each book its message.
Show a small pocket Bible. Still God's word. Size does not make it special.

misconceptions.ask: Who inspired the writing of the Bible?
misconceptions.repair: Say: many people wrote over many years, and God inspired them (2 Timothy 3:16).

misconceptions.ask: When can the Bible guide us?
misconceptions.repair: Read 2 Timothy 3:16 (useful for teaching) and Psalm 119:105 (a lamp to my feet).

checks.question: What does 2 Timothy 3:16 say about Scripture?
Is the Bible the same as a storybook?

skills.key_step: The child states that the New Testament has 27 books and names the four Gospels in order.

floor.prerequisite: Knows the Old Testament has 39 books.
floor.question: How many books does the Old Testament have?

steps: Count the New Testament books on the chart.
Name the four Gospels in order.

board.do: Write two shelves: Old Testament 39, New Testament ?
Wait for the child to say 27.
Write Matthew, Mark, Luke, John at the start of the New Testament shelf.

misconceptions.ask: How many books are in the New Testament?
misconceptions.repair: Write OT 39, NT 27, total 66 on a two-part bookshelf.

misconceptions.ask: Which of these is a Gospel: Acts or Mark?
misconceptions.repair: Sing the Gospels in order: Matthew, Mark, Luke, John; then Acts comes next, a different kind of book.

misconceptions.ask: Which Gospel comes first in the New Testament?
misconceptions.repair: Use the first letters M, M, L, J in a chant and on flashcards.

misconceptions.ask: In which part of the Bible are the four Gospels?
misconceptions.repair: Open a Bible at Matthew: the New Testament begins here.

checks.question: How many books are in the New Testament?
